title: Saudi Arabia Rejects Houthi Claim of Missile Attack on Aramco in Riyadh
detail: Houthi media claimed a ballistic missile and drone operation hit Aramco in Riyadh, framed as retaliation for Saudi strikes on Sanaa. Coalition spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki Al Malki called the claim misleading, saying the Houthis sought an 'illusory victory' after losses in Taiz. Yemeni government forces separately claimed 260 Houthi fighters killed or neutralised. All figures are unverified claims from the parties.

media.caption: Saudi Arabia rejects Houthi claim of attack on Riyadh
